# Luis Enrique Ramírez López

> Founder, CEO & CTO of Iruz Labs. Senior software architect with 14+ years building distributed systems, now translating engineering into scalable, profitable business models. Based in Estado de México, Mexico. Works remotely.

## Iruz Labs

Iruz Labs (https://iruzlabs.com) is an omnichannel autonomous AI agents platform (AAaaS — Autonomous Agents as a Service). It works across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, SMS, Telegram, and voice calls. The AI agents profile, schedule, prospect, and qualify leads 24/7; a human agent closes the sale with full context. It is industry-agnostic and currently used in retail, real estate, beauty salons, car dealerships, debt collection, and call centers. Clients include Grupo DRT (Mexico) and two other real-estate success stories, plus Integrity Inmo (Colombia) and DBO Graphics (United States), generating a combined ~$1,000+ USD/mo in initial MRR. Selected for Deel's pitch program (AWS for Startups, Deel for Startups perks).

Public conversion metrics (from crm.iruzlabs.com): 6.8% dormant-lead-to-closed-sale conversion, 3x more closed sales, 90% less response time.

- Product/engine: Atenea — https://atenea.iruzlabs.com
- Internal CRM: https://crm.iruzlabs.com

## Background

Before founding Iruz Labs (March 2025–present), Luis led engineering teams at:
- Arkos MX — Tech Lead
- NOLAB — Tech Lead & Product Lead / Senior Full-stack Developer
- Stori — Software Engineer B3 (fintech, payments & topups frontend)
- Publicis Groupe — Fullstack Engineer (PepsiCo client work, including the miNegocio MX app)
- Neta Systems – Grupo Salinas — Fullstack Developer
- CEMEES — Developer (also published in Buzos de la Noticia magazine)

## Skills

AI & autonomous agents, LLMs, vector databases, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, Kafka, AWS (6+ years), GoLang, Node.js, Python, TypeScript, React, Vue.js, Astro, Docker, Terraform, PostgreSQL, MongoDB. Certified by NVIDIA (Generative AI) and IBM (Python for Data Science).
